title: Scaffold project
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: Run create-next-app in the project root (TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, App Router, src dir, alias @/*). Do not overwrite AGENTS.md, docs/ or .agents/.
Install the dependencies listed in fypms-scaffold-roadmap (no email provider).
tsconfig: strict true and noUncheckedIndexedAccess true.

Create the empty folder skeleton from spec section 11 (src/components/{ui,auth,navbar,students,defense,common}, src/lib/{firebase,auth,models,export,matching}, src/types, src/context, src/config) with .gitkeep files.

package.json scripts: typecheck, lint, test (vitest run), test:watch, test:rules (firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"), test:server (emulators:exec with vitest.server.config.ts), e2e (playwright test).
vitest.config.ts (node env, alias @ -> src, include src/**/*.test.ts), vitest.rules.config.ts (include tests/rules/**, 30s timeout), vitest.server.config.ts (include tests/server/**, 30s timeout).
.env.example with every variable from fypms-scaffold-roadmap and empty values; .gitignore covers .env*, .firebase, node_modules, playwright-report, test-results.
One placeholder unit test so `npm run test` is green.
acceptance: npm run typecheck, lint and test pass
npm run dev serves the default page
